business_summary: Beijing YJK Building Software Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, sale, and technical services of software products in China and internationally. The company offers structure and green building software products; and construction software, including YST steel structure detailing design software, foundation pit support software, Yingjianke BIM construction safety calculation toolbox, YJK-MJJS BIM scaffolding finite element analysis calculation software, YJK-MJ BIM formwork and scaffolding design software, YJK-LMB aluminum formwork design software, YJK-SGCB BIM construction site layout software, and Yingjianke bridge construction temporary structure BIM design software.It also provides ArchiCAD, a 3D architectural design software; and BIM series software products, such as BIMFire General Digital, Yingjianke BIM Structural Design, Yingjianke Water Supply and Drainage BIM Design, Yingjianke BIM Digital Collaborative Design, Yingjianke Substation 3D Digital Design, Yingjianke Architectural BIM Design, Yingjianke HVAC BIM Design, Yingjianke Electric's BIM design, and Yingjianke Collaborative Design Tool Software. In addition, the company offers prefabricated, bridge, and water conservancy platforms; and Rebro mechanical and electrical engineering BIM software. Further, it is involved in software development; provision of data processing and storage support, conference and exhibition, technical, technical development, technical and educational consulting, and technical exchange services; and advertising design and agency, advertising placement, and import and export of goods businesses. The company's products are used in residential buildings, office buildings, stadiums, roads and bridges, municipal facilities, subway stations, industrial plants, petrochemicals, power and new energy, civil buildings and infrastructure, and other industrial applications. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: 베이징 YJK 빌딩 소프트웨어 유한 회사 중국 및 국제적으로 소프트웨어 제품의 개발, 판매 및 기술 서비스에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 구조 및 친환경 건축 소프트웨어 제품을 제공합니다. YST 강철 구조 상세 설계 소프트웨어, 기초 피트 지원 소프트웨어, Yingjianke BIM 건설 안전 계산 도구 상자, YJK-MJJS BIM 비계 유한 요소 분석 계산 소프트웨어, YJK-MJ BIM 거푸집 및 비계 설계 소프트웨어, YJK-LMB 알루미늄 거푸집 설계 소프트웨어, YJK-SGCB BIM 건설 현장 레이아웃 소프트웨어 및 Yingjianke 교량 건설 임시 구조물 BIM 설계 소프트웨어를 포함한 건설 소프트웨어도 제공합니다. 3D 건축 설계 소프트웨어인 ArchiCAD; BIM Fire General Digital, Yingjianke BIM 구조 설계, Yingjianke 상하수도 BIM 설계, Yingjianke BIM 디지털 협업 설계, Yingjianke 변전소 3D 디지털 디자인, Yingjianke 건축 BIM 설계, Yingjianke HVAC BIM 설계, Yingjianke Electric의 BIM 설계 및 Yingjianke 협업 설계 도구 소프트웨어와 같은 BIM 시리즈 소프트웨어 제품. 또한 이 회사는 조립식, 교량 및 수자원 보존 제품을 제공합니다.
